_comment: Input file for RTL AOC Verification Workflow
_instructions: This provides the required ground concepts for the verification process
_note: File paths are plain strings - the paradigm handles reading
_execution_note: Phase 1 extracts AOC schemas from specs, Phase 2 verifies RTL trace against AOC rules

_ground_concepts_overview.{trace file path}: Path to RTL simulation trace file (input)
_ground_concepts_overview.[counters]: Initial counter list for iterative AOC extraction loop
_ground_concepts_overview.{previous active rules}: Initial empty state for active rules (first iteration default)

{ISA file path}._description: Path to the ISA specification file
{ISA file path}._note: Contains normative text about instruction behaviors, resolution rules, atomicity requirements

{MA file path}._description: Path to the microarchitecture specification file
{MA file path}._note: Contains implementation details about issue queue, LSU, reservation handling

{trace file path}._description: Path to the RTL simulation trace file
{trace file path}._note: JSON trace of simulation events with time, signal, and value fields

[counters]._description: Initial counter list for the AOC extraction loop
[counters]._note: Starts with [1], grows via $+ continuation until extraction is complete

{previous active rules}._description: Initial state for active rules in verification loop
{previous active rules}._note: Empty on first iteration, carries forward via %^ modifier
